assessments.reason: The original finding identifies a real ambiguity: ordinary buffer completion uses completeBuffer, while cancelRequest calls internal cancel and then completeRequest; doCancelRequest cancels and signals each pending buffer internally. The final prose and English pairs distinguish these paths and retain the CameraManager call-thread obligation for completeBuffer and completeRequest.
assessments.needed_change: Retain the revised ordinary-completion and cancellation distinction. Correct the separate diagram issue identified below.

assessments.reason: The added source establishes the chain: cancelRequest calls Request::Private::cancel, which calls doCancelRequest; the latter cancels each pending buffer and emits bufferCompleted before cancelRequest calls completeRequest.
